claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings, monitoring for weaning readiness given improving spontaneous breathing and low FiO2 requirement.
Monitor coagulation status closely given supratherapeutic INR (up to 4.1) and elevated PTT; assess need for reversal or adjustment of anticoagulation.
Monitor and manage metabolic acidosis with anion gap elevation (bicarbonate 15-16, anion gap 19-22, base excess -8 to -9); evaluate for causes and consider bicarbonate therapy if worsening.
Monitor renal function with elevated creatinine (4.7-4.9 mg/dL) and BUN (52-57 mg/dL); assess urine output and need for renal replacement therapy.
Monitor and replace magnesium given hypomagnesemia (1.4 mg/dL); consider IV magnesium supplementation.
Monitor and manage blood pressure with ongoing vasopressor support (norepinephrine infusion); titrate to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure.
Monitor vancomycin trough level (11.7 ug/mL) and renal function to guide dosing; consider need for dose adjustment.
Monitor lactate levels (2.2-2.5 mmol/L) as marker of tissue perfusion; reassess with hemodynamic changes.
Monitor temperature (up to 100.5°F) and evaluate for infection; continue current antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin) as ordered.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium using RASS and CAM-ICU; target light sedation (RASS -2) and monitor for delirium.
